title: Sweet Eggplant and Oyster Mushroom Stir-Fry
description: Sweet Eggplant and Oyster Mushroom Stir-Fry is a comforting Thai-style vegetable dish that combines tender eggplant, juicy oyster mushrooms, fragrant aromatics, and a savory-sweet sauce. Finished with fresh Thai basil, it pairs perfectly with steamed jasmine rice.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
items: Thai eggplant – 1 medium, cut into bite-sized pieces
Oyster mushrooms – 100 g, cleaned and separated
Thai bird’s eye chilies – 1–2, sliced (adjust to taste)
Fresh Thai basil leaves – for garnish
Cornstarch – 1/2 tsp mixed with 1 tbsp water (optional)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Eggplants
steps: Soak the cut eggplants in salted water for 10 minutes to reduce bitterness and prevent browning. Drain well.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Eggplants
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the eggplants and stir-fry for 5–7 minutes until softened and lightly browned.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Sauté Aromatics
steps: In the same pan, add the remaining oil.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Add Mushrooms
steps: Toss in the oyster mushrooms and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until they start to soften.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Combine and Sauce
steps: Return the eggplants to the pan.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, palm sugar, tamarind paste (if using), and water/broth.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Simmer
steps: Let the mixture simmer for 3–5 minutes so the eggplant and mushrooms absorb the sauce flavors.
If you want a thicker sauce, stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Finish and Serve
steps: Turn off heat and stir in fresh Thai basil leaves.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.

chefTips: Palm sugar gives the authentic mild sweetness, but brown sugar works well as a substitute.
Tamarind paste adds a hint of sourness to balance the sweetness — feel free to skip if you prefer.
